items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I remember Tubby, and I remember Lil, and Louis, and Oliver. Those are all I can remember right now that were in the band at that time.

ctx.x: And who was in the band there?

Well, now, they had Lil Armstrong. She wasn't a Lil Armstrong then. I don't know what her name, but later on she married Louis. And King Oliver had the band there then. And Louis was on the, I should say the second trumpet, because King Oliver played the, you know, he was on the first trumpet, I guess. I don't know where they're placed in the band, but King Oliver and Lil, she were at the piano. That's where her and Louis met. I don't know if they met there, but I mean they worked together and they married from…
Did you know any of the other fellas in the band?
